review_notes: F2 sentinel ownership/identity. Missing copy hooks duplicate the unique sentinel; the public prompt overstates this as always raising. The visible command checks both sentinel identity and that normal enclosing mutable containers still copy independently. Restore only __copy__/__deepcopy__ returning self. Frozen missing tests only enter Phase B; original 1 F2P and 411 P2P retained.

arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PYREPLAY'
import copy
from boltons.typeutils import make_sentinel
marker = make_sentinel("MISSING")
container = {"marker": marker, "items": [1]}
cloned = copy.deepcopy(container)
observed = (copy.copy(marker) is marker, copy.deepcopy(marker) is marker, cloned["marker"] is marker, cloned is not container, cloned["items"] is not container["items"])
print("sentinel_identity_and_container_isolation:", observed)
assert observed == (True, True, True, True, True)
PYREPLAY
